text.description_html:
Acorn AIJBQ, 6-1/2 Inch Heart Tip Cabinet Strap Smooth Iron Hinge

The 6-1/2" Smooth Iron Strap Hinge is suitable for light weight doors or cabinets. Its old world charm is in both the heart tip design and in the smooth iron finish which is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago. The Smooth Iron Cabinet Heart Tip Strap Hinge has a lifetime no rust warranty. Click Here to see the entire Acorn Heart Tip Collection

Also Available: 6-1/2 Inch Smooth Iron Cabinet Heart Tip Offset Strap Hinge and 6-1/2" Rough Iron Cabinet Strap Hinges

Features for the Acorn Heart Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the 6-1/2" Heart Tip Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • For doors whose face sits flush with the door frame.
  • Length: 6-1/2"
  • Width: 1-3/4"

Sold as a pair (2-hinges).
